unresolved_gaps: No matched monthly series was found for total revenue and aggregate AI startup token spending at either company.
Available spending measures do not isolate the whole AI startup ecosystem or reconcile direct purchases with reseller purchases.
No causal evidence was found showing whether other customer and product revenues could sustain growth when startup spending stopped increasing.
The claim does not specify an accounting basis, preventing a decisive financial comparison under the stated grading rules.
